newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba aims to boost global PC sales 50% in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba aims to boost global PC sales 50% in 97/98.

text.p: Toshiba Corp said on Monday that it aims to sell more than four million notebook and desktop personal computers on the global market in fiscal 1997/98, up about 50 percent from 2.7 million units in 1996/97.
Of that four million, notebook computers will account for three million units and desktop PCs will account for the remaining one million.
In the Japanese market, Toshiba aims to sell 850,000 PCs, 75 percent of which will be notebook computers.
The targets were contained in a statement distributed at a news conference launching a new model of home-use PCs equipped with a DVD-ROM drive.
